messages:
olivia: Heads-up — APAC edge saw a 95th->99th tail jump after last night's customer rollout, looks like multi-tenant contention on the NVLink fabric.
ravi: Ugh. Any hint noisy neighbor or cold-kvcache churn?
olivia: Both. KV cache miss rate spiked and we saw >2x PCIe stall events on one rack. Logs: `pci_stall=2.1x, kvcache_miss=78%`.
sam: Do we know which tenant(s)? can we shard them into a dedicated micro-pool temporarily?
olivia: It's a single large tenant that moved to fractional shared slices. They push lots of long-chat requests with big context windows.
anya: If we carve dedicated fractional slices we lose egress credits and cost goes up. Can we try routing constraint first — prefer cross-az warm pools for that tenant? less hot fabric congestion.
jen: Routing constraints sound good. What's the temporary policy we want to try?
olivia: Proposal: add a tenant-level route tag `avoid-edge-fabric` for heavy-context sessions. Policy rules:
```
if request.context > 2048 and tenant in heavy_list:
  route -> warm-pool-cross-az
  allow_burst -> false
```
Start as canary for 10% of their traffic.
ravi: Also recommend quick KV-cache prefill for their common prefixes. We can do a short TTL warming job to cut miss rate.
sam: How do we measure success? Which metrics to watch?
olivia: Watch: p99 latency (+/-), PCIe stall counts, kvcache_miss, segment_queue_depth. If p99 drops by >25% and kvcache_miss falls, keep rolling.
infra-bot: experiment created: exp-1769003333-routing-canary (10%). Monitoring dashboards: link https://console/redwood/exp/1769003333
anya: Cost note — cross-az warm-pool traffic may incur egress delta ~0.3 c/s per token. Finance flagged if sustained. We'll need an approval path if >24h.
jen: Can infra run the canary now? I can toggle route flags.
olivia: Please run canary at 12:10 UTC. Also push a prefill job:
```
kubectl run kvcache-prefill --image=tools/prefill:latest --env TENANT=acct-129 --args "--warm-prefixes=/common/* --ttl=30m"
```
sam: Running the canary now.
infra-bot: canary toggled -> 10% traffic routed to warm-pool-cross-az at 2024-05-08T12:10:12Z
ravi: Early readout: p99 down 18% in first 5m, kvcache_miss down to 52% (was 78%). PCIe stalls also trending down.
anya: Good signal. Keep canary for 2h, then we can either expand or try dedicated micro-slice for the tenant if it persists.
jen: Noted on cost escalation. If we expand beyond 12h we loop in finance.
olivia: Thanks all — will update after 2h. :thumbsup:
